parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the rotation lids of a cardboard box, made of corrugated cardboard sheet.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a flap that can be opened or closed to cover the box and protect its contents.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the top edge of the box, allowing it to open and close.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is another rotation lid of the cardboard box, made of the same corrugated cardboard material.
parts.Functional_description: It works together with the other lid to fully close the top of the box.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its hinge line at the top edge of the box to open or close.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: This part is an outlier flap of the box, made of cardboard, typically used for additional closure or reinforcement.
parts.Functional_description: It may provide extra sealing or structural support when the box is closed.
parts.Movement_description: It can fold inward or outward depending on the box’s closure configuration.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the cardboard box, forming the container’s base and sides.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and supports the contents of the box, providing structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move; it serves as the fixed base for the rotating lids.
